community.title: Keyboard layout, two sticks (DOSBox)
community.notes: DOSBox ignores the controller, so keys: Options=Esc, Cross=Enter, Square/R2=Ctrl attack, Circle=Space use, left stick Up/Down + comma/period strafe, right stick Left/Right turn, L3=Shift run.
